title: Template and artifact lookup
rules: Load templates only through returned resource URIs.
Review target or bundle paths instead of inlining artifact bodies.

sections.heading: Templates
sections.body: Use `cadre_read` for a returned template inventory or artifact schema resource.

sections.heading: Generation
sections.body: Setup, newtrack, revise, refresh, release, handoff, and artifact sync return staged artifact descriptors. Approve the current stage before execution.

sections.heading: Intelligence
sections.body: Use returned `intel.lsp_*` or `intel.dap_*` actions for setup and checks.
